items.name: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
items.what: Single emergency number for police, fire and ambulance.

items.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal / Helpline
items.what: Report financial fraud, hacking, online harassment and other cybercrime.
items.how_to: Call 1930 immediately after a financial fraud, then file the complaint online.

items.name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
items.what: Pre-litigation consumer grievance redressal and guidance.
items.how_to: Register a grievance online or call 1915 (also 1800-11-4000).

items.name: e-Daakhil (online consumer case filing)
items.what: File consumer complaints in District/State/National Commissions online.
items.how_to: Register, upload complaint and documents, pay fee online if applicable.

items.name: NALSA / District Legal Services Authority
items.what: Free legal services for eligible persons.
items.how_to: Call 15100 or visit the DLSA office in the district court complex.

items.name: Tele-Law
items.what: Legal advice from panel lawyers through Common Service Centres.
items.how_to: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre.

items.name: CHILDLINE
items.what: Emergency help for children in distress.

items.name: Elderline
items.what: Support and information for senior citizens.

items.name: CPGRAMS (Public Grievance Portal)
items.what: Lodge grievances against central/state government departments.
items.how_to: Register and submit your grievance with documents; track status online.

items.name: RTI Online (central government)
items.what: File RTI applications to central public authorities online.
items.how_to: Fill the form, pay the fee online. For state departments use the state's RTI portal.

items.name: RBI Complaint Management System
items.what: Complaints against banks, NBFCs and payment providers after the entity has not resolved it.
items.how_to: First complain to the bank; if no reply in 30 days or reply unsatisfactory, file on CMS.

items.name: IRDAI Bima Bharosa
items.how_to: Complain to the insurer first, then register on Bima Bharosa.

items.name: SEBI SCORES
items.what: Complaints against listed companies and SEBI-registered intermediaries.

items.name: State RERA authority
items.what: Every state has its own RERA website for projects and complaints.
items.how_to: Search '<your state> RERA' and use the official .gov.in site.
